Here, we build and store the models required to obtain vital rate parameters to feed to the IPM.

## Setup

As usual, we fist load the package and get the data.

```{r}
library(whereipm)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)

# loading the data
data <- ipmdata
```

To study how the evolution of dispersal and life-history affects the spatial ecology of the population we are splitting the 5 years of observation in 3 phases:

1. Early phase, between a month after introduction and month 12;
2. Mid phase, between month 26 and 37;
3. Late pahse, between month 51 and 62.

I will also subset the dataset to include only pools, and only females.

```{r}
# subsetting for sex, habitat and time (here I am building a model for females in pools, only in the early phase)
data.early <- data %>%
  filter(Habitat == "P" & sex == "F" & time>=1 & time<=20)
data.mid <- data %>%
  filter(Habitat=="P" & sex=="F" & time>=21 & time<=41)
data.late <- data %>%
  filter(Habitat=='P' & sex=='F' & time>=42 & time<=62)
```

## Models

I will run 6 model trios, for different life-history and dispersal traits:

1. Survival;
2. Recruitment;
3. Adult dispersal probability;
4. Adult dispersal distance;
5. Natal dispersal probability;
6. Natal dispersal distance.

### Survival

```{r, results = "asis"}
e.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ s_loc_density +
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.early,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# in early phase survival is not affectd by density

m.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ s_loc_density +
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.mid,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# in mid survival is not affected by density

l.survival <- lme4::glmer(survival ~ s_loc_density +
                            + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                          data=data.late,
                          family=binomial,
                          lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# in late phase survival is not affected by density

stargazer::stargazer(e.survival, m.survival, l.survival,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Models for survival",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Survival probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```

### Recruitment

```{r, results = "asis"}
e.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                              ziformula = ~ 1 +
                                + (1|FishID)+  (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data = data.early,
                              na.action = na.omit)
# in the early phase, density affects the number of offspring but not the probability to produce any.
m.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                              zi = ~ 1 +
                                + (1|FishID) + (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data=data.mid,
                              na.action = na.omit)
# in the mid phase number of offspring is negatively affected by density
l.recruit <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(recruited ~ s_loc_density +
                                + (1|FishID) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                              zi = ~ 1 +
                                + (1|FishID) +  (1|sampling),
                              family="truncated_poisson"(link="log"),
                              data=data.late,
                              na.action = na.omit)
# the late phase is not affected by density

sjPlot::tab_model(e.recruit, m.recruit, l.recruit,
                  pred.labels = "Local density",
                  dv.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                  show.ci = F)
```

### Adult dispersal

```{r, results = "asis"}
e.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ s_loc_density +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data.early,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# no effect of density on dispersal in early phase
m.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ s_loc_density +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data.mid,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# positive density dependent dispersal probability for the mid part (higher dispersal at high density)
l.dispersal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_moving ~ s_loc_density +
                               + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                             family = 'binomial',
                             data = data,
                             lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# strong positive effect of density on dispersal in the late phase

stargazer::stargazer(e.dispersal.p, m.dispersal.p, l.dispersal.p,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Adult dispersal probability",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```

### Adult dispersal distance

```{r, results = "asis"}
e.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ s_loc_density +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (1|sampling),
                               data = data.early)
# early phase distance does not depend on density
m.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ s_loc_density +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                               data = data.mid)
# neither does the mid phase
l.dispersal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_moved) ~ s_loc_density +
                                 + (1|FishID) + (1|reach) + (s_loc_density|sampling),
                               data = data.late)
# and neither the late phase

stargazer::stargazer(e.dispersal.dist, m.dispersal.dist, l.dispersal.dist,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Models for adult dispersal distance",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal distance",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```


### Natal dispersal probability

```{r, results = "asis"}
e.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = data.early,
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# strong negative density dependence early on
m.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = data.mid,
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# strong negative density dependence in the middle
l.natal.p <- lme4::glmer(p_natal ~ s_loc_density.mid +
                           + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                         family = 'binomial',
                         data = data.late,
                         lme4::glmerControl(optimizer=c('bobyqa')))
# no effect late 

stargazer::stargazer(e.natal.p, m.natal.p, l.natal.p,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Natal dispersal probability",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal probability",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```

### Natal dispersal distance

```{r, results = "asis"}
e.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ s_loc_density.mid + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                           data = data.early)
# no effect of density on distance in early phase
m.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ s_loc_density.mid + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                           data = data.mid)
# higher distance at higher density in the mid phase
l.natal.dist <- lme4::lmer(log(dist_natal) ~ s_loc_density.mid  + 
                             + (1|Maternity) + (1|reach.birth) + (s_loc_density.mid|sampling.birth),
                           data = data.late)
# no effect in late

stargazer::stargazer(e.natal.dist, m.natal.dist, l.natal.dist,
                     type = "html",
                     title = "Natal dispersal distance",
                     report = "vcsp*",
                     column.labels = c("Early phase", "Mid phase", "Late phase"),
                     dep.var.caption = "Dispersal distance",
                     dep.var.labels = "")
```
